guidance: Several of our hospitals featured in Newsweek’s World’s Best Hospitals 2026 and Outlook’s National Best Hospital Rankings, including 12 specialty rankings.
With a current bed capacity of 10,840 and a pipeline of 4,230 additional beds, we are heading towards the 15,000- bed capacity target that we spoke about earlier.
capex: Our expansion will build upon this reach with a pipeline of 4,230 additional beds, taking total capacity from 10,840 to over 15,000.
With occupied beds growing at 8%, which is faster than the operational bed capacity, occupancy improved by 335 basis points to 68%, demonstrating better utilisation of our expanded bed base.
risks: Sunil Kumar M R – Group Chief Financial Officer Before we begin, I would like to remind everyone that some statements made on today’s call may be forward-looking in nature and are subject to risks and uncertainties.
focus: In these first 100 days, we have focused on bringing our people and our operations together, ensuring seamless continuity of patient care, and sharing clinical expertise across our network.
We are delivering these benefits hospital by hospital while remaining focused on the quality of care, the efficiency of our operations and the trust patients place in us.

As we execute our expansion programme, we remain focused on disciplined investment in capacity and clinical capabilities, continued to realise the integration benefits, and careful management of debt and liquidity.

about: Aster DM Healthcare Limited is one of the largest integrated private healthcare service providers operating in GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council) countries and an emerging player in India. With an inherent emphasis on clinical excellence, it is one of the few entities in the world with a strong presence across primary, secondary, tertiary and quaternary healthcare. [1]
